name: flair
description: Self-hosted identity, memory, and soul for AI agents. Persistent semantic memory, personality (soul), and relationships via a local or remote Flair/Harper instance — not a cloud memory SaaS.

FLAIR_AGENT_ID.title: Flair agent ID
FLAIR_AGENT_ID.description: Agent identity for memory scoping. Must match `flair agent add <id>`.

FLAIR_URL.title: Flair URL
FLAIR_URL.description: Reachable Flair HTTP origin. Local Cursor can use the default. Grok Bot / cloud agents cannot see the user's laptop localhost — they need a hosted or tunneled instance.

FLAIR_KEY_PATH.title: Ed25519 key path
FLAIR_KEY_PATH.description: Optional path to the Ed25519 key. Defaults to ~/.flair/keys/<id>.key on the machine that runs npx. Do not put this in mcp.json — set it in the host env of that machine.

FLAIR_ADMIN_USER.title: Admin username
FLAIR_ADMIN_USER.description: Optional Basic auth username for standalone Flair when a key file cannot be mounted. Never commit values. Set in the host env of the machine that runs npx, not in mcp.json.

FLAIR_ADMIN_PASSWORD.title: Admin password
FLAIR_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Optional Basic auth password for standalone Flair when a key file cannot be mounted. Never commit values. Set in the host env of the machine that runs npx, not in mcp.json.
